gen-gf-gugi-gf-ovo: Ovo is a serif with only a faint thin-to-thick shift. Gugi above it draws every stroke at full visual weight, so the two feel like a shout followed by a measured reply.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-fs-literata: Wire-straight strokes define Happy Monkey, bold and unshaded. Literata follows in a text serif with a modest thick and thin rhythm, so paragraphs move along with a bookish, sturdy steadiness.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-fs-sentient: Happy Monkey spreads its gaps wide in the e, with lines that never vary in thickness. Sentient pulls its apertures tight and does the quiet, refined work.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-fs-erode: Loose, loud and level-handed. Love Ya Like A Sister keeps its strokes contrast-free, while Erode, a text serif, gently swells and tapers, and that tension between them is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-fs-hoover: Love Ya Like A Sister has ascenders that barely clear its x-height, giving it a squat, outlined swagger. Hoover, a text serif with a generous opening into the e and compressed ascenders, makes a longer passage feel compact and refined.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-fs-trench-s: Trench Slab is a text serif whose lowercase sits almost level with its capitals, giving it a dignified, compact look. Love Ya Like A Sister above it keeps vertical and horizontal strokes identical, so a generous heading size would let it stand out.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-esteban: Expressive and unshaded, Love Ya Like A Sister never lets its line swell. Esteban, a refined serif with an oversized lowercase and subtly etched thin parts, gives the pair its strongest quality: one plain-spoken, one finely cut.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-faustina: Faustina reads like a classic serif sharpened to a carpenter's pencil taper, with an open-jawed c and capitals barely taller than the lowercase. Love Ya Like A Sister's single line weight makes the difference the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-halant: Halant brings a faint pressure shadow, like worn charcoal, and a towering x-height to the page. Love Ya Like A Sister stays ruler-straight above it, so the two sit as loud, level hand and weathered, traditional classic serif.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-headland: Chunky, outspoken and unshaded, Love Ya Like A Sister swells nowhere in its bowls, while Headland One, a text serif, adds modest weight change. One carries the shout, the other the widely spaced, dignified paragraphs.
